gen-dafont-disorder-gf-marcellus-sc: Chaotic and raw, Disorder looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with no swelling where curves meet stems. Marcellus SC then settles the page with gently modulated strokes.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-montagu-slab: Disorder draws every letter with a pencil-line consistency, spaced well apart. Montagu Slab has sturdy downstrokes and slimmer crossbars, so a long paragraph reads with traditional, refined steadiness.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Disorder's strokes carry no shading whatsoever, and its tall lowercase stands well apart. Noto Serif Hentaigana brings visible, medium-key modulation, and that tension is what makes the two interesting.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-ovo: Raw and chaotic, Disorder draws each letter with a single constant line width and a high, oversized lowercase. Ovo steps in with moderate modulation and shallow ascenders to steady the page.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-esteban: Esteban keeps its thin strokes only slightly slimmer than the stems, with an e that never squeezes shut. But Dogica's heavy, widely tracked lettering above it lets paragraphs unfold in a refined, classic voice.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-faustina: Faustina thins its bowls gracefully rather than sharply, and its c opens like a pair of pliers. Dogica shouts in heavy display; Faustina does the quiet, authoritative talking.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-halant: Halant reads traditional and authoritative, with a faint but real shift in stroke weight and outward-pointing terminals. Yet Dogica's heavy, wide-set lettering against that tall, sturdy x-height makes a commanding combination.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Dogica spreads heavy letters wide, with lowercase nearly as tall as capitals. Hedvig Letters Serif follows with mild stress and open-ended curves, so its solid, readable strokes let the heading be loud.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-lisu-bosa: Dogica is heavy, wide-spaced and low in contrast. Lisu Bosa brings gentle modulation, spilling counters and sturdy tall lowercase, so paragraphs feel comfortable and unhurried as they run on.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its terminals pulled back and its strokes mildly modulated. But Dogica handles the loud, heavy statements, while the text serif handles the fine detail.
